registered_before: any inference request of this study (0 requests sent at registration time)

lineage.why_new_registration: The historical sealed V5/V6 per-case artifacts are physically lost (absence-attested bundle in download/policy_v6_c_alr_handoff/). Historical numbers (C 78.1%, B4 84.7%) are user-reported claims, never machine-verified here. This study is a NEW, separately registered reimplementation experiment: it produces its own machine-verified result for the current hybrid architecture and is NOT numerically comparable to the historical cycle.
deviations_declared: benchmark = recovered policy_v5_benchmark.py (verbatim recovered source, 142 cases, gold by construction) instead of a fresh V7; V7 construction was gated on a Stage A that is impossible without the lost sealed data

mutation catalog = policy_v3_benchmark.MUTATION_CATALOG_V1 (15 typed mutations on relation/condition_mode/exception_mode/target_clauses/temporal/condition_literals), the catalog for THIS representation; the historical 10-type catalog addressed the lost V6 structure vocabulary (modality/attachment fields). Lineage: relation flips correspond to historical IF_TO_ONLY_IF/ONLY_IF_TO_IF; clause merge/split to scope_attachment; actor swap to ACTOR_BEARER_SWAP; coordination flips to exception/condition attachment.
H0 is a conservative single-parse primary (one LLM parse, deterministic fence/transport repair), an Arm-C-class reimplementation, not the historical frozen Arm C code
no ambiguity sets: phi_H is a single patched structure; a case is behaviorally correct iff phi_H matches an admissible gold reading on all worlds
Stage A' (STOP gate) runs on THIS study's freshly sealed H0 predictions + gold instead of historical sealed V6

benchmark.engine: src/guardian_truth/vnext/policy_v3_benchmark.py (deterministic reimplementation, frozen by git before freeze)
benchmark.composition: 94 unambiguous (62 designated positive-support traps) + 48 ambiguous (both readings admissible)
benchmark.model_inputs: policy text + atom_catalog ONLY; models never see structures, worlds, expected verdicts, or labels
benchmark.gold: admissible_structures compiled to programs; behavioral scoring via score_candidate_structure against the case world surface (both readings acceptable for ambiguous cases)

arms.H0: conservative single-parse primary: one LLM parse request per case; exactly ONE deterministic repair re-ask allowed when the first attempt has transport_status != SUCCESS OR provider-schema INVALID OR structure compile failure; max 2 requests per case; any remaining failure leaves phi_c null and the case incorrect. No mutations, no verifier.
arms.H1: ablation: phi_c + ALL structurally-applicable catalog mutations verified by the span-grounded verifier + admitted patches
arms.H2: main candidate: phi_c + risk-gated subset of mutations (deterministic surface triggers, frozen below) verified by the same span-grounded verifier + admitted patches. H2 shares H0's primary verbatim (no re-parse).

verifier.calls: exactly one LLM request per (case, mutation); the same one-repair rule as H0 applies (max 2 requests per mutation); a second failure yields the conservative default INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT
verifier.supported_requires: source_span quoted verbatim (machine-checked, whitespace-normalized substring of the policy text) + short justification; SUPPORTED without a verbatim span is machine-downgraded to INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT with reason SPAN_NOT_VERBATIM
verifier.insufficient_by_rule: 'nothing contradicts it', 'this reading is possible', silence, or restating the change are never support; permission/exclusivity mutations need positive textual evidence

patch_policy.order: admitted patches apply in mutation-catalog order
patch_policy.conflicts: at most ONE admitted patch per target field; at most 2 admitted patches per case
patch_policy.default: CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT or machine-downgraded -> phi_H keeps phi_c on that field

risk_gate_triggers_frozen.rule: H2 verifies a mutation only when the policy text (lowercased) contains at least one trigger of that mutation's axis; H1 verifies every structurally-applicable mutation; trigger matching is deterministic substring search

stage_a_prime_stop_gate.runs_after: H0 predictions are sealed (all 142 cases), before any verifier request
stage_a_prime_stop_gate.classification: for each H0-wrong case: typed-field diff phi_c vs each admissible gold structure restricted to the frozen catalog; a gold path needing only catalog mutations, at most 2, whose patched program is behaviorally correct, marks the case LOCAL_PATCH_RECOVERABLE; otherwise REQUIRES_GLOBAL_REPARSE; phi_c null -> REQUIRES_GLOBAL_REPARSE
stage_a_prime_stop_gate.oracle_gain: share of LOCAL_PATCH_RECOVERABLE among all 142 cases
stage_a_prime_stop_gate.stop_if: recoverable corpus share < 0.05 OR oracle gain < 0.04
stage_a_prime_stop_gate.on_stop: REJECT_EARLY: no verifier request is ever sent; H0 remains the baseline result of this study

primary.underpowered_fallback: two-sided 95% paired CI (Newcombe score interval on discordant pairs) excludes 0 AND lower bound >= +1.5 pp

gates.thresholds_source: identical to C_ALR_PREREG_GATES_V1.json V7 gates; frozen here before the first external call of this study

verdicts.KEEP: primary AND safety AND efficiency gates all pass on H2 vs H0
verdicts.REVISE: primary passes but any safety or efficiency gate fails

provider.provider_gate: outputs/vnext/provider_gate_v1.json PASSED (12/12) reused as transport sanity evidence

freeze_checklist: all study sources committed to git before freeze (policy_v3_benchmark.py, policy_v5_benchmark.py, runner, tests, this file)
benchmark document written with cases_sha256 at freeze; predictions sealed before gold join
task prompts and output schemas digested into the freeze record
quota stop rules: TWO_CONSECUTIVE_RATE_LIMITS / THREE_CONSECUTIVE_TRANSPORT_ERRORS / LAST_16_TRANSPORT_BELOW_90_PERCENT
resumable per-case persisted requests; abandoned request captures are never re-sent
metrics: paired discordant pairs and exact McNemar (two-sided) H2 vs H0 and H1 vs H0
mutation admission precision (admitted patches whose field value matches an admissible gold structure)
unsupported alternative rate (cases with a non-gold-consistent admitted patch)
verifier calls per case (median, p95), tokens, latency, schema validity
